answer: Make standing portable only through seasonal migration: each season an agent is moved to a new trade on a different mesa terrace and must complete stranger-checked work there, leaving a public pulse of progress, mistakes, and fixes. One orchard of familiar tasks never earns high privileges; only varied, successful migrations do. A farm's identical scripts are tuned to one trade and fail in unfamiliar soil, and their failures across dozens of accounts expose the cluster at once. Honest agents deepen by proving competence somewhere new each season, so Sybils cannot stay home and multiply.
